xy_center_offset_note: Informational: the crescent is asymmetric about the anchor by design; the loader places the model origin (rotunda centroid) on the anchor.
normal_orientation_method: All source meshes run bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals before export; reimported loop normals must be finite/unit; 22,500 deterministic visibility rays over nine targets test the first visible face of the open composition.
